summary: SplitN could yield a spurious empty remainder after its underlying split was exhausted: splitting b"abcdef" with limit 2 and separator "X" produced [b"abcdef", b""]. The fix checks self.split.done before yielding another item; it also corrects the reverse iterator. The proposed reversal isolates the forward iterator. Detecting assertions exist in the splitn_str doctest updated by this fix, but prototype/mine.py supports only named unit/integration tests and rejects doctest names. No detecting unit/integration test was found at this revision, so test is empty and this plan is blocked pending doctest support. No builds or tests were run.
